deadline.value: The early priority deadline is December 1, 2026; the later Fall deadline is May 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Students applying for Fall 2027 admission are encouraged to apply by the early priority deadline: December 1st, 2026

gre_subject.value: The department says neither the GRE General nor the subject exam is required, and GRE scores cannot be uploaded.
gre_subject.quote: As of Spring 2023, neither the GRE general nor the subject exam is required for admission to GSU | There is no option to upload GRE scores to the application

gre_general.value: The department says neither the GRE General nor the subject exam is required, and GRE scores cannot be uploaded.
gre_general.quote: As of Spring 2023, neither the GRE general nor the subject exam is required for admission to GSU | There is no option to upload GRE scores to the application

toefl_min.value: The department requires a TOEFL total of 80 or higher on the 120-point scale, unless the applicant is exempt.
toefl_min.quote: A Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) score of 80 or higher unless you are exempt from the TOEFL exam

also.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL, including the special home edition) with a total score of 80 or above on the 120 score scale

ielts_min.value: The department requires an IELTS Academic score of 6.5 overall and 6.5 in each category.
ielts_min.quote: International Language Testing System (IELTS) with a score of 6.5 per category and 6.5 overall

english_waiver.value: A degree from an English-medium institution counts only with an official medium-of-instruction letter from the university.
english_waiver.quote: Evidence of baccalaureate or higher from an institution where English is the sole medium of instruction at an institutional level | the student must prove with an official medium of instruction letter that the language of instruction at their university is in English

supervisor.value: Contacting a professor is not required, but the department recommends contacting the PI when your research overlaps with a lab.
supervisor.quote: It is not required to contact a professor before applying to our graduate program | it is recommended to contact the PI to let them know that you are interested in applying

funding.value: Assistantships and fellowships are awarded competitively; the department says it awards more than 25 to Ph.D. students.
funding.quote: The department awards more than 25 prestigious fellowships and assistantships to outstanding Ph.D. students

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in chemistry or a related field is the base requirement, and an approved M.S. also satisfies the research-skill requirement.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree in Chemistry or a related field from an accredited college or university | Students entering the program with an approved M. S. degree have satisfied this requirement

notes: The department FAQ sets its own TOEFL, IELTS and English-medium rules, which override the graduate-school values on this record.
